capabilities.name: ai.provider-access
capabilities.summary: Explicit provider access through native subscriptions, API credentials and local inference without implicit paid fallback.

capabilities.name: audit.record
capabilities.summary: Canonical tamper-evident audit trail entry (who, what, outcome, source) with its legacy hash chain, plus the accepted-not-admitted audit-jcs-sha256/v1 persisted-entry profile.

capabilities.name: auth.authenticate
capabilities.summary: Authenticate an actor for a tenant through an approved identity provider.

capabilities.name: cache.typed
capabilities.summary: Provider-neutral typed cache with governed key namespaces, mandatory TTL and explicit availability outcomes.

capabilities.name: calendar.event.create
capabilities.summary: Create a governed calendar event through an approved provider adapter.

capabilities.name: data.query
capabilities.summary: Execute governed read-only data queries through approved data provider adapters.

capabilities.name: design.login-pattern
capabilities.summary: Ready-to-use SSO login screen pattern (layout, state mapping and accessibility) where the consumer owns authentication through callbacks.

capabilities.name: design.mobile-tokens
capabilities.summary: Mobile design tokens (colors, spacing, radius, typography) as plain-value themes for React Native and Flutter, projected from the Helix design system.

capabilities.name: drive.file.upload
capabilities.summary: Upload a governed file through an approved drive provider adapter.

capabilities.name: http.correlation-id
capabilities.summary: HTTP middleware contract that reads or generates one correlation id per request, exposes it to downstream code and echoes it on the response (X-Correlation-ID by default).

capabilities.name: llm.generate
capabilities.summary: Generate model output through governed LLM provider adapters.

capabilities.name: logging.entry
capabilities.summary: Canonical structured log entry shared by every stack (timestamp, level, service, message, optional trace_id, span_id, context and error).

capabilities.name: mcp.invoke
capabilities.summary: Invoke an MCP tool through the governed Capability Gateway without duplicating tool logic.

capabilities.name: messaging.consumer
capabilities.summary: Message consumer group configuration shared by the backend-core stacks (subscriptions, retry with total-attempt semantics, dead letter, idempotency gate). Configuration shape only; lease requests belong to messaging.outbox-lease and messaging.inbox-lease.

capabilities.name: messaging.event-envelope
capabilities.summary: Canonical envelope shared by every platform event and message.

capabilities.name: messaging.inbox-lease
capabilities.summary: Transport-neutral fenced lease request over the Inbox delivery identity (tenant, consumer, message_id), used for idempotent consumption; same request shape as messaging.outbox-lease.

capabilities.name: messaging.outbox-lease
capabilities.summary: Transport-neutral fenced lease request over the Outbox delivery identity (tenant, consumer, message_id); no broker confirmation and no global exactly-once guarantee. Base of the lease request shape also used by messaging.inbox-lease.

capabilities.name: messaging.publish
capabilities.summary: Provider-neutral event publish port (destination, receipt, PublishAsync) over the canonical event envelope; no broker confirmation, durability or exactly-once guarantee.

capabilities.name: notification.send
capabilities.summary: Send a governed notification through an approved provider adapter.

capabilities.name: observability.health
capabilities.summary: Standard health check response (status, service, version, uptime, per-dependency checks) and the rule that aggregates checks into an overall status.

capabilities.name: resilience.http
capabilities.summary: Common HTTP retry policy (retries after the first call, exponential backoff, delay bounds, per-attempt timeout) shared by the .NET and Go backend-core stacks; circuit breaker and total timeout are .NET-specific and excluded.

capabilities.name: security.authn
capabilities.summary: Authentication provider interface and bearer-token middleware configuration shared by every stack.

capabilities.name: telemetry.publish
capabilities.summary: Publish governed telemetry events, metrics, traces, and audit-compatible operational signals.

capabilities.name: workflow.execute
capabilities.summary: Execute a governed workflow with tenant, audit, telemetry, and retry policy.

capabilities.name: workitem.command
capabilities.summary: Execute explicit resumable work item mutations with durable uncertainty handling.

capabilities.name: workitem.query
capabilities.summary: Read bounded neutral work items and transitions.
